collection_contract: Collect all tests; every node outside the required files is explicitly outside_profile, never passed. Required setup, call and teardown must pass without skips or xfail.
scope: Balanced positive-sequence motor direct-on-line starting and restart
EX-03 exact case hashes and five discrete scale tuples in requirements/ex03-case-manifest.json
Two clean offline wheel installations, OpenDSS smoke and synthetic SI motor trace replay
Public reference models and parameter sets; own laboratory equipment is not required

known_failures_and_exclusions.reason: Full mixed OEL/UEL/PSS cold 30-second native design exhausted its 120-second budget; ESST1A-only native long case is a separate qualified scope.
Machine-epsilon UEL clock policy can exceed the one-microsecond reset-clock criterion; conditioned_1e-8 is an explicitly different numerical policy.
Five measured scale tuples do not establish arbitrary equipment combinations or unlimited scale.
No universal EMT, unbalanced-network, OEM controller or site qualification claim.
Requires a published exact commit, successful workflow_dispatch, live GitHub API bindings and fresh signed GitHub-hosted-runner attestation verification.
